# 2. 友商的实现情况

|  
|特性|友商|实现情况|
|---|:---|:---|:---|
|YDBRD-33989 字符集相关|CHARSET|MySQL|返回指定的字符串的字符集,如果参数为       `NULL`    ，       `CHARSET()`       函数将返回       `binary`  ,入参为常量字符串，默认返回数据库character_set_server设置的字符集|
||COLLATION|MySQL|返回指定的字符串  对应的字符序,如果参数为     NULL  ，     CHARSET()     函数将返回     binary,入参为常量字符串，默认返回数据库character_set_server设置的字符序|
|YDBRD-33992 兼容schema\version|DATABASE|MySQL|返回当前（默认）数据库的名称|
||SCHEMA|MySQL|返回当前 schema名称|
||VERSION|MySQL|返回当前DB版本信息|
|YDBRD-33995 User相关|CURRENT_USER|MySQL|当前登陆用户对应在user表中的哪一个|
||SESSION_USER|MySQL|当前用户    
|
||SYSTEM_USER|MySQL|当前用户    
|


# 3. 示例

## CHARSET/COLLATION

  


|  
|场景|用例|  
|  
|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|入参为  常量字符串|```
select charset('aaa');
select charset(' ');
select charset('');

select collation('aaa');
select collation(' ');
select collation('');
```|  
,  
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a899/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ba1ad9a3311de26eb/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),  
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ba1ad9a3311de26ec/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a89a/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),  
,  
,  
|  
,  
,  
,  
|
|2|入参非字符串，返回 binary|```
select charset(111);
select charset(true);
select charset(null);

select collation(111);
select collation(true);
select collation(null);
```|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ba1ad9a3311de26ed/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ba1ad9a3311de26ee/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|崖山还不支持binary|
|3|函数返回结果  varchar(64)|```
create or  replace view v1 as select charset(null);
desc v1;
create or  replace view v2 as select collation(null);
desc v2;
```|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a89b/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|  
|
|4|当建表指定单独的字符集|```
drop table if exists table_charset;
CREATE TABLE table_charset ( id int ,str varchar(10) ) CHARACTER SET cp850  ;
insert into table_charset values (1,'a');
insert into table_charset values (2,'name');
insert into table_charset values (3,null);

select charset(id) from table_charset;
select charset(str) from table_charset;

select collation(id) from table_charset;
select collation(str) from table_charset;
```|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ba1ad9a3311de26ef/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),非字符串仍然返回 binary；,但字符型的null 返回对应修改的charset；,且collation即便未单独指定，也会返回与charset对应的值,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a89c/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|  
|
|5|当建表对COLUMN指定单独的字符集|```
drop table if exists table_charset_column;

CREATE TABLE table_charset_column ( 
str1 char(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci ,
str2 varchar(20) CHARACTER SET tis620 COLLATE tis620_thai_ci
) ;
insert into table_charset_column values (1,'a');
insert into table_charset_column values (2,null);
insert into table_charset_column values ('a',1);
 

select charset(str1) from table_charset_column;
select charset(str2) from table_charset_column;

select collation(str1) from table_charset_column;
select collation(str2) from table_charset_column;
```|  
,根据实际设置返回,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a89d/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ba1ad9a3311de26f0/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|  
|
|6|在以上场景的基础上新增列|```
-- 新增列
alter table table_charset_column add COLUMN str3 varchar(10);
insert into table_charset_column(str3) values ('a');
 
select charset(str3) from table_charset_column;
select collation(str3) from table_charset_column;
```|新增列返回结果同数据库server的设置,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a89e/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|  
|
|7|返回转换字符集的字符串,  
|```
select charset(convert('aaa' using gb18030));
select collation(convert('aaa' using gb18030));
```|  
,** 带字符集返回，字符序同样**,  
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a89f/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|  
|
|8|mysql对字符集的设置影响范围|show variables like '%character%';,show variables like '%collation%';,  
,  
,| character_set_client    设置客户端使用的字符集；    
  | character_set_connection    设置连接数据库时的字符集，如果程序中没有指明连接数据库使用的字符集类型则按照这个字符集设置；    
  | character_set_database    默认创建数据库的编码格式；    
  | character_set_filesystem   文件系统的编码格式，把操作系统上的文件名转化成此字符集，即把 character_set_client转换character_set_filesystem， 默认binary是不做任何转换的；    
  | character_set_results    数据库给客户端返回时使用的编码格式，如果没有指明，使用服务器默认的编码格式；    
  | character_set_server    服务器安装时指定的默认编码格式；    
  | character_set_system   数据库系统使用的编码格式，这个值一直是utf8，不需要设置，它是为存储系统元数据的编码格式；,| character_set_client   只是字符集安装目录,  
|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ba1ad9a3311de26f1/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a8a0/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|  
,当前崖山只会返回两种：binary和数据库设置的字符集,其余表级，列级均不生效|


  


## DATABASE /   SCHEMA

|  
|场景|用例|  
|  
|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1| 查询当前数据库名称|```
select database();
```|  
,  
,**  **,  
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43b8970c2af4f53a8a1/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),  
,  
,  
,  
|  
,  
,  
,崖山返回的是 当前用户名称 / 默认同名schema名称 ？|
|2|SCHEMA DATABASE 功能一致 |```
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS testtmp;
use testtmp;
select database();
select schema();

drop database testtmp;


-- drop后查询为null
select database();
select schema();
```|在MySQL中，CREATE SCHEMA创建了一个数据库，这是因为CREATE SCHEMA是CREATE DATABASE的同义词。 换句话说，你可以使用CREATE SCHEMA或者CREATE DATABASE来创建一个数据库。,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ca1ad9a3311de26f2/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43c8970c2af4f53a8a2/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),  
|  
|
|3|多session连接|session1 use  database1,session2 use database1  后drop database1 –  ** 这里mysql 成功，崖山报错**,session2 查询为null；session1 仍然可以查询,session2 重建同名database1 ，session1  session2  查询database1 都正常|  
|  
|
|4|返回值类型,varchar(34)|```
create or replace view v1 as select database();
desc  v1;



create or replace view v1 as select schema();
desc  v1;
```|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ca1ad9a3311de26f3/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)|  
|
|5|函数名作为表名|拦截|  
|  
|

## CURRENT_USER /   SESSION_USER / SYSTEM_USER

|  
|场景|用例|  
|  
|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|USER 和   CURRENT_USER|```
select user,host from mysql.user  order by user,host;

mysql -c -uhuxp
select user();
select current_user();
```,user()是用来显示当前登陆的  **用户名与它对应的host**,currrent_user()是用来显示当前登陆用户对应在  **user表中**  的哪一个,**SYSTEM_USER() 等价 USER()  **,SESSION_USER()   **等价 SYSTEM_USER() 和  USER() **|  
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ca1ad9a3311de26f5/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),  
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ca1ad9a3311de26f6/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),  
,  
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739e43ca1ad9a3311de26f7/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),  
,  
,  
,  
|  
,  
,  
,  
|
|2|  
create USER时指定 hostname,|```
create USER  'USERtest01'@'localhost' identified by 'Ttest@1234';

mysql -c -uUSERtest01 -pTtest@1234
select user();
select system_user();
select session_user();


select current_user();
```|  
,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673afc518970c2af4f53b516/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673afc848970c2af4f53b518/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),|  
|
|3|create USER时指定IP地址|```
drop user 'USERtest01'@'localhost';


 create USER  'USERtest01'@'192.%.%.%'  identified by 'Ttest@1234';
select user,host from mysql.user  order by user,host;

mysql -c -uUSERtest01 -h '192.168.6.169' -pTtest@1234
select user();
select system_user();
select session_user();


select current_user();
```|,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673affaaa1ad9a3311de336f/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b00bda1ad9a3311de3372/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b00eaa1ad9a3311de3373/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),|,|
|4|create USER时指定 ‘%’|```
drop USER  'USERtest01'@'192.%.%.%';

 create USER  'USERtest01'@'%'  identified by 'Ttest@1234';
select user,host from mysql.user  order by user,host;

mysql -c -uUSERtest01   -pTtest@1234
select user();
select system_user();
select session_user();

select current_user();

drop USER   'USERtest01'@'%' ;

```|,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b0135a1ad9a3311de3374/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b015ba1ad9a3311de3375/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),,,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b0163a1ad9a3311de3376/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),,||
|5|create USER时不指定，默认 ‘%’|```
 

 create USER  'USERtest01'  identified by 'Ttest@1234';
select user,host from mysql.user  order by user,host;

mysql -c -uUSERtest01   -pTtest@1234
select user();
select system_user();
select session_user();

select current_user();

drop USER   'USERtest01' ;
```|![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673d4abe8970c2af4f53b603/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673d4b09a1ad9a3311de3449/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673d4b12a1ad9a3311de344a/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)||
|6|用户名为空|```

create USER  ''  identified by 'Ttest@1234';
select user,host from mysql.user  order by user,host;

mysql -c -uxx   -pTtest@1234
select user();
select system_user();
select session_user();

select current_user();

drop USER   '' ;
```|![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673ed0488970c2af4f53b6c5/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673ed0f18970c2af4f53b6c7/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673ed0ec8970c2af4f53b6c6/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ)||
|7|函数名作为表名,,,USER system_user session_user 支持,,current_USER 不支持|```
 create table USER(a int);

drop table if exists  USER;


create table system_user(a int);
drop table if exists  system_user;

 create table session_user(a int);
 drop table if exists  session_user;


-- 不支持
create table current_user(a int);
 drop table if exists current_user;

```|,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b02b28970c2af4f53b51e/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b02f68970c2af4f53b51f/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),,||
|8|函数返回值,|,,```
create or replace view view1 as select system_user() ;
desc view1;

create or replace view view1 as select session_user() ;
desc view1;

create or replace view view1 as select current_user() ;
desc view1;
```|,,,![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673b0376a1ad9a3311de337a/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..OimRHnjcxyTIhTwKzRvbPsswLDyIbzZOE4cWoLe12AQ),|,,,yashan 返回什么？是否是,varchar（64）|
